title: Technical Product Owner
description:

ABOUT USSyniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‐drivenTechnical Product Ownerto serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key Skills Visionary Leadership:Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic. Visual Communication:Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big- Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have. Be Curious- Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action- Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together- Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About NatureCoNatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);  plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;  proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA. Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo. públicos não técnicos Conhecimento em conceitos de mensuração digital: eventos, dimensões, métricas, atribuição e modelos de funil Perfil analítico com autonomia para conduzir projetos de ponta a ponta com poucos direcionamentos Experiência com ferramentas de Gestão de Projetos como JIRA e Confluence Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum ou Kanban Capacidade de gerir e disseminar conhecimento técnico com analistas de menor senioridade.Você pode se destacar se tiver: Experiência com Python ou R para análises mais avançadas (segmentação, modelos preditivos, análise estatística) Conhecer ferramentas de análise de comportamento como Hotjar, Clarity ou similares Vivência com plataformas de CRM Analytics ou dados de mídia paga integrados ao contexto de web analytics (Insider One, Salesforce) Processos de implementação ou migração de ferramentas de analytics (ex: UA → GA4) Migração de dados entre Data Warehouses (Big Query → AWS) Conceitos de privacidade de dados e suas implicações na coleta (LGPD, consentimento, server-side tracking) Plataformas de cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Ai Development Orchestrator em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Location:RemoteType:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;  the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;  the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;  the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;  quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

description:

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!  Sobre a área:   Responsável por avaliar o desempenho do negócio, incluindo seus serviços e unidades realizando estudos, avaliações e análises do negócio que resultam na geração de valor financeiro ou não no Grupo Fleury  Principais atividades:  Acelerar as implantações das sinergias de negócios Auxiliar gestores da marca no modelo de gestão adotado atualmente no grupo Suporte à marca na implementação e condução de rituais de gestão para auxiliar os negócios na tomada de decisão, tendo como algumas das entregas: Fóruns quinzenais/mensais de negócios Forecast e estimativas (previsões de receita, volume e margem) Acompanhamento de ações táticas (PMO) Elaboração do Planejamento estratégico e orçamento Análises de diagnóstico e elaboração de planos de ação Avaliação e implementação de oportunidades (benchmark com demais marcas do grupo e identificação) Construção de relatórios e indicadores de desempenho Construção de Estudos de Viabilidade Atender as demandas dos gestores de negócios realizando estudos de grande complexidade e planos para correção dos desvios;  Construir planos para o cumprimento do orçamento de receita e margem, apoiando as unidades de negócios;  Avaliar e recomendar alterações de mix de serviços e unidades;  Auxiliar na definição de oferta de serviços nas unidades e identificar oportunidades de expansão ou redução da oferta assegurando o alcance das metas financeiras acordadas;  Entregar resultado financeiro dos negócios e da companhia;  Contribuir paraa otimização dos resultados internos por meio da análise de indicadores e relatórios Financeiros e operacionais, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e recomendando mudanças nos procedimentos da área;  Atuar com o desenvolvimento e execução de projetos que refletem diretamente na satisfação e fidelização dos clientes;    Buscamos alguém que apresente:  Formação: Ensino Superior Completo Informática: SAP, Pacote Office Conhecimento avançado de Finanças (análise de DRE, construção de estudos de viabilidade);  Conhecimento avançado na manipulação de base de dados e na ferramenta excel;    Diferenciais:   Conhecimentos específicos em visualização de dados para Analytics, Inteligência Artificial e Aprendizado de Máquina são diferenciais;    Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.  Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:    -  Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;   -  Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;   -  Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;   -  Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;   -  Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;   -  Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.  Informações da vaga:  Modelo de Trabalho (100% Presencial - Região Campinas, com disponibilidade para viagens a cada 15 dias) Carga Horária: 220h Escala: Segunda á sexta Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48  Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!   Saúde e Bem-estar:   -  Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;   -  Ambulatório comclínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;   Proteção e estabilidade:   -  Seguro de vida.  Facilidades para o dia a dia:   -  Vale-Transporte;   Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.   Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.  Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.  Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site:   O Grupo Fleury informa que a participação em seus processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhuma empresa terceira está autorizada a cobrar valores para a candidatura às vagas, ao treinamento, ao material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada

Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.REQUISITOSFormação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);  Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE(Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);  Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil); Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.Local de Trabalho: REMOTORemuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.IMPORTANTE:MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Oncologista.

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Product Owner em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Olá, futuro(a) PO (Product Owner PL/SR) ! Estamos em busca de um Product Owner versátil, capaz de atuar em duas frentes estratégicas: tirar novas ideias do papel (Zero to One) e liderar a transformação digital de processos existentes, convertendo operações manuais ou complexas em experiências digitais fluidas. Mais do que organizar tarefas, você será o responsável por estruturar a solução. Seja concebendo um produto inédito ou modernizando um fluxo operacional, sua missão é garantir que cada decisão técnica e de negócio tenha um propósito claro. Você atuará na intersecção entre estratégia, processos e tecnologia, impulsionando a entrega de valor real. Onde você vai jogar (Time e Estrutura): Você fará parte de uma estrutura robusta e colaborativa. Não atuará isolado(a), mas sim como peça central de uma célula multidisciplinar composta por: Time de UX/Design: Para garantir fluidez e usabilidade. Squad de Desenvolvimento & QA: Engenheiros focados em performance e qualidade. Especialistas de Negócio: Stakeholders com profundo conhecimento de mercado, com os quais você trocará experiências diariamente para desenhar a melhor solução. Seus Desafios e Responsabilidades: 1. Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado) Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna. Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento. Entrega Incremental (MVP): Definir a primeira versão do produto com assertividade. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real. 2. Engenharia de Processos e Lógica Mapeamento de Cenários (As Is / To Be): Mergulhar na operação para entender o cenário atual e projetar o processo futuro otimizado. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente. Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico. 3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document) Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento. Wireframing e Prototipação Básica: Para demandas de menor complexidade ou validações rápidas de fluxo, você deve ter autonomia para desenhar wireframes ou mockups funcionais. Lógica de Dados: Estruturar logicamente quais dados, filtros e critérios são necessários para a construção de relatórios e telas, facilitando o trabalho da engenharia. Requisitos (O que buscamos em você) Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes. Raciocínio Lógico Estruturado: Facilidade para quebrar problemas grandes em etapas menores, sequenciais e lógicas. Habilidade com Fluxogramas: Experiência em desenhar processos de forma visual (BPMN ou fluxos livres). Escrita Técnica de Excelência: Capacidade de detalhar requisitos cobrindo cenários de sucesso, erro e exceção com clareza impecável. Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias. Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total. Diferencial Competitivo IA como Copiloto: Buscamos profissionais que já incorporaram a Inteligência Artificial no seu fluxo de trabalho diário. Valorizamos quem sabe utilizar a IA como um parceiro intelectual e alavanca de produtividade — seja para estruturar cenários, refinar documentações, gerar insights de dados ou acelerar o dia a dia. PARA ISSO, OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ TRABALHAR CONOSCO: 01) Salário: A combinar (Enviar pretensão salarial) 02 Segunda a Sexta 03) Horário: 08h às 17h 04) Local de trabalho: Prédio Sky Galleria (no Shopping Galleria), na Cidade de Campinas/SP 05) Regime de trabalho: HÍBRIDO (seguindo os critérios da política interna) 06) Regime de contratação: CLT 07) Plano de carreira 08) Cesta básica R$250,00 09) Vale refeição no total de R$ 32,00/ dia 10) Vale transporte c/ desconto 6%, pago em dinheiro ou Auxilio combustível fixo de R$ 300,00 11) Benefícios de VR, Cesta e Auxilio combustível, pagos através de um cartão unificado e flexível, operadora pela Sólides, para utilização na modalidade de crédito, bandeira Mastercard e que é aceito em uma infinidade de estabelecimentos 12) Convênio Farmácia,que conta com ofertas exclusivas e crédito de R$ 300,00 com desconto em folha de pagamento 13) Confraternizações: última quarta-feira (COFFEE BREAK) do mês 14) Parceria com Instituição de Ensino Anhanguera/Grupo Cogna 15) Descontos em lojas e restaurantes do Galleria Shopping 16) Estacionamento do shopping com valor reduzido, pago mensalmente diretamente à administração Estamos ansiosos para ter você conosco!

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior Machine Learning Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here.This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us. What you'll do Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.G., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.  What we're looking for We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you. You'll be successful in this role if you have: Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.G., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.G., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).  Nice to have (not required) Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.G., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval.  Why Join Us You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction. Equal Opportunity Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

Proactively identify and drive opportunities for process automation, system optimization, and user experience enhancements. Troubleshoot critical production issues, including system unavailability and data integrity issues, and propose resolutions or workarounds. Ability to replicate & diagnose issues using industry-standard tools and techniques (e.G., FTP, Postman, AWS Tools), and propose resolutions or workarounds. Provide end-to-end support (L1–L3) for Veeva RIM and Veeva SafetyDocs platforms, including issue diagnosis, resolution tracking, and proactive system monitoring. Veeva API: Collaborated with the BOT development team to provide Veeva RIM API endpoints to facilitate automation and system integration. Learning Management Coordinators: Contributed to the setup of the Veeva RIM Trainings module within the eLMS Quality Suite, enabling streamlined training compliance track. PleaseReview: Serve as a technical point of contact for both Standalone and Veeva-integrated PleaseReview applications, managing user access, configuration, and performance optimization and licenses management. Lorenz docuBridge: Manage the full lifecycle of Lorenz docuBridge, including user provisioning, license management. Lorenz iSubmit: Support the installation, configuration, and issue resolution of the iSubmit application, ensuring compliance with internal and external submission standards. Word Templates: Worked configuration and of the Starting Point Template application used in regulatory document workflows. iLovePDF: Install, configure, and troubleshoot iLovePDF and other auxiliary document processing tools for high-volume regulatory submission tasks. ServiceNow: Be responsible for Request and Incident tickets and/or customer escalations and drive progress until resolution.  Mandatory Skills: Fluent English. Experience with the life science and healthcare industry. Knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11 and validation processes in a regulated environment. Strong technical skills in configuration, and issue resolution in Windows-based enterprise environments. Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.G., ServiceNow) and Request/ incident/change management processes. Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global, cross-functional teams. Experience with documentation tools and version control systems is a plus.  What do we offer? This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion, processing, and delivery system, integrating data and high-performance querying. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture, driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the our clients digital ecosystem. Help lead team members in the design, development, and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture. Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products, ingesting, processing, and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores. Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem. Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management. Migration of legacy applications and services to our core data ingestion and GraphQL workflows. Experience with Javascript/TypeScript, Python, Node.Js. Experience with relational, NoSQL, and key-value data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis. Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloud-based environment with high transaction volumes, using a variety of connected services. Proficiency with modern build strategies, continuous integration, unit testing, and automated integration tests (GitHub, issue tracking tools like Jira, and CI/CD related disciplines like GitOps). Ability to design solutions, provide estimates, and evaluate risk and technical feasibility. BS Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical degree, or equivalent professional experience.  You might also have: Wundergraph, Cosmo, or Apollo GraphQL experience. AWS Certifications. Experience with extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines using cloud services and frameworks (a plus). Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation. Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering, product, and architecture. Energetic self-starter who can work in a complex, collaborative environment that rewards innovation, initiative, curiosity, and mentoring. Knowledge of sports and gaming.

description:

Are you obsessive about catching what others miss?Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look? Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems? Final question: when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away? If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads QA role. At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry. Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients' brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously. This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent. This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error. However, it is not a "task-ing" role, or a role where you'll be constantly told what to do - you'll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems. ** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY ** You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions: Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you've completed the Willo, and we will be in touch. assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters  Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity Identify discrepancies such as: Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations Inconsistent implementation across platforms Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup  Budget & Pacing Verification Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly  Tracking, Links & Technical QA Verify accuracy and functionality of: URLs and landing pages UTM execution against: Internal strategy direction Client Success Manager requests Campaign updates or pivots Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely  Audit Documentation & Communication Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence Categorize issues based on severity (e.G., minor discrepancy vs. critical error) Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution  Audit Operations (Evolving Scope) This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including: Audit Cadence: Pre-launch validation Post-launch verification Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits  Audit Coverage: Full account audits Targeted sampling across accounts  Audit Depth: Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links) Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy)  Ownership Scope: Identifying and flagging discrepancies Recommending corrective actions Supporting enforcement of quality standards  Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must: Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments Have strong written communication skills Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment  Preferred Experience: Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking) Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.)  Nice to Have: Salesforce or CRM familiarity Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards Experience documenting processes or building SOPs Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment  Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required): Meta Ads Manager Google Ads Google Tag Manager (GTM) TikTok Ads LinkedIn Ads TradeDesk  Why Our Work Matters: Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn't teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn't enough. That's where Crisp comes in. We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it's a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors. Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably. About Crisp: Crisp has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 (Fastest Growing Private Companies in the U.S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022). Crisp ( is the nation's fastest-growing law firm growth company. We've helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue. Crisp has been featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal. description:

Post ProducerLocation: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content. Role Overview As a Creative Producer, you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners. Key Responsibilities 1. Post Production Operations Management Oversee day-to-day post-production operations for ongoing audio shows and promotional adds, ensuring smooth workflows from raw audio to final delivery. Manage editing, sound design, mixing, and mastering pipelines to meet release schedules. 2. Post Production Team Coordination Work closely with editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, and external post-production vendors to deliver high-quality audio content. Ensure clear briefs, efficient collaboration, and consistency across outputs. 3. Production Planning & Pipeline Management Collaborate with content and production teams to plan post-production schedules, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of all episodes. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the pipeline. 4. Stakeholder Collaboration Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to align on timelines, creative requirements, and delivery standards. 5. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release. 6. Vendor & Partner Management Build and manage a network of external studios, freelancers, and post-production partners to support scalable content production. Ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery across partners. 7. Feedback Integration & Continuous Improvement Monitor listener feedback and internal QC inputs to identify issues related to audio clarity, pacing, sound design, or technical quality. Drive improvements across post-production processes. 8. Process & Workflow Optimization Continuously enhance post-production workflows, tools, and standards to improve efficiency, scalability, and output quality. Document best practices, templates, and guidelines for consistent execution. 9. Volume & Deadline Management Manage high-volume content pipelines across multiple shows, ensuring all deadlines are met without compromising on audio quality or production standards. 10. Quality Control Training & Creative Alignment Continuously train and support QC team members responsible for assigned shows to ensure strong alignment on creative direction, audio quality standards, storytelling expectations, and technical benchmarks. Work closely with QC specialists on a weekly basis to review content, calibrate feedback, identify recurring issues, and maintain consistency across shows and post-production outputs. 11. Internal Promotional Video Post-Production Leadership Lead the internal post-production team for promotional video assets, aligning editors, sound designers, and mixers around consistent quality standards, sonic identity, creative style, and delivery expectations. Ensure all promotional videos maintain a cohesive audio language, polished sound design, and production value aligned with brand and marketing objectives. 12. AI-driven Innovations and tool adotion Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards. Qualifications 7+ years of experience in post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows. Solid understanding of audio storytelling and hands-on experience across post-production stages, including editing, mixing, mastering, and finishing for podcasts or audiobooks. Proven experience working with post-production teams such as editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, or external production vendors. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple post-production pipelines and deadlines simultaneously. Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across content, production, and quality teams. Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while maintaining consistent quality standards. Self-driven with strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production challenges.

A Sprache&Wissen (S&W) é uma empresa brasileira fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora de alemão doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-idiomas. A S&W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, com a meta de capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 98,9%.Principais atividades (na Alemanha): Cuidado direto ao paciente em ambiente hospitalar ou clínico Administração de medicamentos e acompanhamento de tratamentos Documentação clínica e comunicação com equipe multidisciplinar em alemão Participação em plantões conforme escala do empregadorRequisitos: Diploma de Enfermagem (bacharelado) reconhecido no Brasil Idade máxima de 36 anos (requisito do programa de visto alemão) Disponibilidade para estudar alemão por até 2 anos até o nível B2, com flexibilidade de horários Comprometimento com a carga horária do curso e as etapas do programa Documentação em dia para solicitação de visto (passaporte válido ou possibilidade de emitir)Diferenciais: Conhecimento prévio de alemão (qualquer nível) Experiência em UTI, emergência ou centro cirúrgico Experiência internacional ou intercâmbio Inglês intermediário ou avançadoSobre o período de estudos (home office): O curso de alemão é 100% online — você estuda do Brasil enquanto se prepara Mentoria gratuita em grupo durante toda a jornada até o B2 Flexibilidade para conciliar com seu emprego atualEtapas do processo: Inscrição e triagem inicial Entrevista com o time da S&W Aprovação de ficha e documentações Assinatura do contrato com garantia de emprego Matrícula no curso de alemão (até o nível B2) Match com recrutador alemão Colocação profissional na Alemanha

title: Consultor(A) Funcional Salesforce - Pleno
description:
Empresa está contratando Consultor(A) Funcional Salesforce - Pleno em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Consultor(a) Funcional Salesforce (Sales & Service Cloud)A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como consultor Funcional, você atuará como Key User funcional especializado em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, sendo a ponte entre o time comercial (vendas e atendimento) e as áreas técnicas de TI. Seu principal objetivo é garantir a correta utilização da plataforma, aumentar a produtividade dos usuários, traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais e apoiar a evolução contínua dos processos de CRM, sempre com foco na experiência do cliente e na eficiência operacional. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar usuários comerciais no uso diário do Salesforce, tirando dúvidas, resolvendo problemas de navegação e promovendo boas práticas. Executar atividades operacionais relacionadas a processos de vendas (ex.: criação e acompanhamento de oportunidades, leads, contratos) e atendimento (casos, resolução de solicitações). Detalhar requisitos de negócio junto aos times de vendas, marketing e serviços, transformando demandas em especificações funcionais claras para o time técnico. Validar soluções funcionais antes da liberação em produção, realizando testes de aceitação (UAT) em Sales Cloud e Service Cloud. Homologar novas funcionalidades, fluxos e relatórios, garantindo que atendam aos critérios de negócio e qualidade. Identificar gargalos e melhorias nos processos comerciais e de relacionamento com clientes, propondo ajustes na configuração ou no uso do sistema. Participar de rituais ágeis (daily, review, planning) com o time de CRM, trazendo a visão do negócio. Criar e manter documentação de suporte, manuais e treinamentos para usuários finais. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Experiência prática comprovada em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud (mínimo 2 anos atuando como key user, analista funcional ou consultor). Conhecimento sólido de processos de vendas, CRM e atendimento ao cliente (ex.: ciclo de leads, oportunidades, casos, SLAs). Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais claros e testáveis. Boa comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir com usuários negócio e times técnicos. Visão de processo e pensamento analítico para identificar melhorias e resolver problemas. Perfil colaborativo, paciente e didático para treinar e apoiar usuários com diferentes níveis de maturidade digital. Você pode se destacar se: Possuir certificações Salesforce, como Salesforce Certified Administrator ou Sales Cloud Consultant / Service Cloud Consultant. Tiver experiência com configurações básicas na plataforma (criação de campos, objetos, perfis, fluxos de aprovação, relatórios e dashboards). Demonstrar conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (Flow, Process Builder) ou integrações (API, middleware). Já tiver atuado em projetos de implantação ou migração de CRM. Apresentar familiaridade com métricas comerciais (funnel de vendas, tempo médio de resposta, NPS, etc.) e capacidade de criar KPIs no Salesforce. Ter experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, utilities, telecom) que exigem governança e rastreabilidade. Mostrar proatividade na gestão de mudanças e no treinamento de novos usuários (produção de materiais e workshops). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

title: Sr Ai Engineer - Brazil
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Sr Ai Engineer - Brazil em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior AI Engineer PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTOA trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it. PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop. We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it. Why this role existsWe're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound. If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you. This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them. Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product.What you'll buildThe voice-to-action pipeline.Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab. The recommendation engine.Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue. The credit scoring models.Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals. The data flywheel.Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence. US market integrations.Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, PartsTech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics.What you bring3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production.Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways. NLP or voice experience.You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts.You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality.You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred.You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries.Requirements Timezone:Must be available during US/LatAm business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment:This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel:Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that.What makes this differentAt most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day. You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical Project Manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About the CompanyFraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions. About the Role The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations. Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.  Qualifications 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.  Required Skills ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.  What Success Looks Like Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.  Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.
